title: Ontario permit-to-start-to-completion conversion evidence
question: Which permit intentions become starts, completions, and occupancy?
why_it_matters: Building permits are upstream intentions. FTFN needs conversion evidence to know whether approvals become starts, completions, occupied units, or stalled projects.
current_support: FTFN has Statistics Canada permits, CMHC starts/completions data, and Toronto application 24 254930 records showing the move from initial notice to a revised staff recommendation and servicing review.
candidate_records: specific Toronto building permit for application 24 254930
next_action: Track application 24 254930 into a building permit or start record and add geography-specific CMHC conversion evidence.
notes: Phase 51 added an application-stage recommendation and servicing review, but the permit-to-start-to-completion gap remains open until downstream project and geography-specific records are selected.
